entries.description: One list over the documents of several kinds. Its rows are the documents' own - one per written document of each kind it lists - with the columns every document has: Ref, Date, Number, Posted and DeletionMark, and DocumentType - the type of the document a row is, a Type. The journal has a Read right of its own; inside it each document is read under its own rights, and one the user may not read is left out. A query reads them as DocumentJournal.<Name>, the journal's list form shows them, and the manager has Select, GetForm, GetListForm and GetTemplate.

A selection over the journal's rows of a period, walked as a document's selection is: Next() moves to the next row and answers whether there was one, Reset() starts again. The row's columns are its properties - Ref, Date, Number, Posted, DeletionMark, DocumentType - and GetObject() is the object of the document the row is: an invoice comes back an invoice.
entries.parameters: From - the earliest date; To - the latest; both inclusive. Either may be left out.

entries.description: The journal's list form - the default list form when one is named, otherwise one generated from its columns. Opening a row opens its document.
entries.parameters: Name - a form of the journal, or empty for the default; Owner - the form that owns it; Key - the form's window key.
